evidence: Films of ZnOl,S, were deposited using dimethylzinc, 1% hydrogen sulfide in nitrogen, and the trace oxygen and/or water present (up to 2 ppm) in ultrahigh-purity (UHP) nitrogen. The dimethylzinc was contained in a stainless steel cylinder equipped with a dip tube... Prepurified nitrogen (Canada Liquid Air) served as a carrier gas for the dimethylzinc.
